_doc: Dash steps are earned from board points (levels), spent anywhere out of a fight, with a free respec at lamp-posts; extra charges come from story beats; gear can carry steps; never from level-up cards. Console grants (--dash-step) until the board lands.
_kinds: charge (+amount pips, at most 2 from steps), length (the dash goes amount farther), recharge (charges come back amount sooner), landing (every dash ends in a shove). most: times it may be taken (1 if unset). lamp: the id the board lights. Loaded by logic/Content/DashSteps.cs; checked by tests/DashStepTests.cs.

steps.name: Another Breath
steps.card: One more dash before you must catch your breath.

steps.name: Hard Landing
steps.card: Every dash ends in a shove: lesser things within 2 m are knocked aside.
